scope.evidence_basis: Actual author reconstruction: Verified the order of operations: first compactness, then uniform A convergence and v^TA_jv>=delta|v|^2, then membership in U, then continuity of F. Applying F continuity before proving membership would be invalid. For the cubic example, |a^3-b^3|<=3R^2|a-b| on the bounded range proves uniform convergence; second derivatives and the parameter term also converge uniformly. No nonlinear weak convergence is used. Mean-zero normalization passes by Vol(M) times the sup norm. The compact manifold has no boundary and the conclusion is C2alpha membership, not higher smoothness.

N-H-main: Localize in fixed charts and obtain uniform moduli for every derivative through order two.
Extract on a countable dense set and use finite nets to obtain uniform convergence.
Pass the line-segment integral identity and glue compatible C2 derivatives.
Preserve the alpha bound and prove beta convergence by the interpolation inequality.
Pass the uniform matrix margin before applying joint continuity of F.
Check normalization and a concrete nonlinear C0 passage, and distinguish local exhaustion.
Calculate loss-of-margin, endpoint-exponent and weak-nonlinearity boundaries.

N-H-main.objects: Parameters t, functions u, continuous matrix-valued A and nonlinear residual F.
N-H-main.domain: The immediately adjacent norm definition fixes compact boundaryless M; r>=1 and beta<alpha<1 are explicit.
N-H-main.fixed_and_variable: Backgrounds, exponents, C and delta are fixed before j; subsequence and limit are the conclusion.
N-H-main.hypotheses: Uniform C2alpha bound, a single positive margin, continuity of A and joint continuity of F all remain.
N-H-main.equations: Spaces, U, equation, estimates and conclusions are displayed.
N-H-main.quantifiers: Bounds hold for every j and x; one subsequence converges and its limit solves F at t*.
N-H-main.conclusion: C2beta convergence, C2alpha membership, the retained margin and a C0 residual equal to zero.
N-H-main.status: Conditional established lemma; no PDE existence, bootstrap or alpha-norm convergence claim.
N-H-main.local_definitions: Holder norms are complete immediately before the theorem; matrix positivity uses every vector and the operator norm is specified.
